name: Flax Seeds
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO diets as they're naturally low FODMAP and provide beneficial omega-3 fatty acids without fermentable carbohydrates.
preparationTips: Grind flax seeds before eating to improve nutrient absorption
Store ground flaxseed in refrigerator to prevent rancidity
Add to smoothies, yogurt, or baked goods for omega-3 boost
Can be used as egg substitute when mixed with water
nutritionalHighlights: Excellent source of omega-3 fatty acids (ALA)
High in dietary fiber for digestive health
